sources.entry: Cypht - Feed reader for your email accounts. (Source Code) LGPL-2.1 PHP

summary.one_liner: Cypht is a self-hostable PHP webmail client that combines email from multiple accounts into a single view while also working as a standard email client and news/feed reader.
summary.what_it_does: Cypht merges messages from all of your email accounts into one unified view without replacing the accounts themselves. It works as a standard email client for browsing and managing folders, reading, and sending messages. According to the README, it supports IMAP and SMTP, JMAP, and Microsoft Exchange (EWS, via php-ews). It also functions as a news reader. The README says every feature is a module set (plugin), so features can be added or customized without changing core code.
use_cases: combine several email accounts in one inbox
browse and send email through a webmail interface
read RSS or news feeds alongside email
connect to IMAP, SMTP, JMAP or Exchange mailboxes
customize email client features through plugins
notable: Unifies multiple email accounts into one view rather than replacing them
Built entirely from modules (plugins), so features are swappable
Supports IMAP/SMTP, JMAP and Microsoft Exchange (EWS)
caveats: README does not state specific platform requirements or hosting limits
Install details are on an external website rather than in the README
